title: Hub settlement receipt
description: The Addendum-B3 receipt built by lib/hub/ledger.js receipt(): an APPEND-ONLY aggregate per (batch, wallet), never a single amount/signature pair. `settlements[]` holds one immutable entry per settlement-journal event (Addendum B1: `settle:<sig>:<instructionIndex>[:<innerIndex>]`, the chain's own identity of the transfer and nothing else) — a 100-owed row paid as 40 + 40 + 20 carries three entries and `totals.appliedRaw` is their sum, never any one of them. Two claims are kept distinct and MUST be shown separately: `claims.paymentVerified` (a transfer exists on-chain and matches this row) and `claims.calculationReproducible` (the reproduce export reruns to `totals.owedRaw` — set by that export, never assumed true here; see reproduce-receipt for how a second product reruns it). Overpayment is never floored away and never nets across wallets or projects: a transfer larger than what remained applies only the remainder and reports the rest as `excessRaw`, on this receipt and on the wallet's own funding-status excess, never credited as future accrual and never reducing another wallet's obligation. STATUS: this shape is implemented and unit-tested (scripts/hub-core-test.cjs §7, Addendum B3) but is NOT YET served by any HTTP route — the live GET /api/hub/<project>/r/<sig> route today returns a different, pre-Addendum-B receipt shape from lib/hub/public.js findReceipt() (a buy-competition / Buy Special draw / giveaway / legacy lock-to-earn payout row: { projectId, symbol, program, receipt: { wallet, amountUi, sig, at, state, confirmedAt } }), predating the settlement journal. The design's own `/receipt/<batchId>/<wallet>` route (§5) — the one meant to serve THIS shape — has not shipped; see lib/hub/README.md.

$schema.description: present when the serving route stamps it — points back at this file's served URL.

projectId.description: the project this receipt belongs to.

batchId.description: the batch (see batch.schema.json) this row was paid from.

programVersion.description: the program-version.schema.json `version` the batch paid under — copied from the batch, not re-looked-up.

programHash.description: that version's hash, so the terms that decided this amount are pinned even if the program has since moved to a later version.

rewardMint.description: the mint every raw amount on this receipt is denominated in.

periods.description: the accrual periods the batch (and so this row) covers.

wallet.description: the recipient wallet this receipt is for.

state.description: this row's own settlement state: pending = nothing applied yet; partial = some but not all of `owedRaw` has landed; paid = fully applied; waived = the owner released the remainder (still owed — the next batch draws it).

totals.description: the row's amounts, all raw base-unit decimal strings. owedRaw = appliedRaw + remainingRaw + waivedRaw always; excessRaw is separate — it is money received ABOVE owedRaw and is never subtracted from owedRaw or credited toward it.

owedRaw.description: the row's amount reserved on the batch — what this receipt is FOR.

appliedRaw.description: sum of every settlement's appliedRaw for this row — the part of owedRaw actually settled.

excessRaw.description: sum of every settlement's excessRaw — money verified on-chain to this wallet for this row ABOVE owedRaw. Never negative, never nets against another wallet or another row, never becomes future accrual.

remainingRaw.description: owedRaw − appliedRaw − waivedRaw. Stays reserved on this row (never returns to the wallet's `available`) until it is settled or the owner waives it.

waivedRaw.description: amount the OWNER explicitly released from this row back to the wallet's `available` (still owed; the next batch draws it) — zero unless lib/hub/ledger.js waiveRemainder was called.

settlements.description: append-only, one immutable entry per settlement-journal event that applied to this row, in the order they were recorded. Never rewritten or removed; a later settlement never edits an earlier entry.

xferKey.description: the settlement journal's own key — the chain's identity of the transfer (`settle:<sig>:<instructionIndex>[:<innerIndex>]`) and nothing else. Globally unique across every project; this is what makes a settlement idempotent and un-reusable across wallets or projects (Addendum B1).

sig.description: the transaction signature that carried this transfer.

instructionIndex.description: which instruction in the transaction carried this transfer.

innerIndex.description: which inner (CPI) instruction, when the transfer was not a top-level instruction; null otherwise. Distinguishes two transfers inside one signature.

slot.description: the slot the transaction landed in.

at.description: unix seconds this settlement was recorded.

amountRaw.description: the FULL verified transfer amount — before splitting into applied/excess.

appliedRaw.description: the part of `amountRaw` applied to this row's remaining owed amount at the moment of settlement (min(amountRaw, remaining-before-this-entry)).

excessRaw.description: amountRaw − appliedRaw for this one entry.

verifiedBy.description: how the transfer was verified against this row, e.g. "getTransaction".

claims.description: two DISTINCT claims — never collapse them into one "verified" badge (design §2, test 14: no route or copy may show a "safe"/"verified project" badge).

paymentVerified.description: true once `settlements.length > 0` — at least one on-chain transfer has been matched to this row.

calculationReproducible.description: whether re-running the reproduce export over the published inputs reproduces `totals.owedRaw`. Always null from lib/hub/ledger.js receipt() itself — it is set by the reproduce step (see reproduce-receipt), never assumed here. A version whose inputs were not retained reports this false with "inputs: missing", never fabricates a value.

fundingWallet.description: the project's funding wallet at the time the receipt was built (from the Project record passed in) — null if the caller did not supply a project record.
